en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view taken from a hillside above a rural valley. In the foreground there is sloping ground with low vegetation leading into a dense conifer forest. Beyond the forest lies a patchwork of cultivated fields, small farmhouses and barns, and a curving country road. Farther back, a string of scattered village houses and larger buildings runs along the valley, framed by forested hills in the background. At the far right a church with a tall steeple is visible, serving as the main landmark of the settlement. The scene has no visible printed caption on the image side.
